g.text: C Restored local deficit over the model-specific early window
Exactly three measured pilot sizes per model; common deactivation rule, different fixed native clocks.
Native pilot sizes (Spring: resting L₀). Points are unjoined; compare size dependence within each model.
Bars show empirical numerical sensitivity (3E), not biological confidence intervals.
D Native basal profiles: the same small/large pairs as A
Physical interval coordinate (native units); profile concentration scales differ across models.
All panels use linear 1D states. Spring profiles use measured physical domains 1.049→2.049.
